title: Centres of Excellence | KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Centers of Excellence INSTITUTIONAL ECOSYSTEM A broader layer of academic and societal engagement VISION These centers extend the university's role beyond teaching into research, innovation, international collaboration, career readiness, social responsibility, and disaster management. SCOPE The page content is sourced from the old centers listing and reorganized here so it reads like a cohesive academic overview rather than a bare directory. STRATEGIC FOCUS AREAS What These Centres Enable Area 01 Interdisciplinary research, outreach, and applied innovation. Area 02 Student-facing platforms that extend learning beyond classrooms. Area 03 Centres designed to connect academia with community, industry, and global partnerships. CENTER DIRECTORY Our Centers Center of Excellence Krishna Centre of Innovation Research (KCIR) Krishna Centre for Research and Innovation fosters cutting-edge research aligned with societal, national, and global issues, aiming to enhance India's competitiveness. View Center → Center of Excellence Krishna Center of Institutional Social Responsibility (KCISR) KCISR focuses on social welfare initiatives by engaging students and employees and emphasizing environment, community and research-driven social solutions. View Center → Center of Excellence Krishna Center of International Affairs (KCIA) KCIA fosters global connections through student exchange, foreign student support, collaborations and international research-learning opportunities. View Center → Center of Excellence Krishna Center of Career Advancement and Corporate Training (KCCACT) KCCACT supports career exploration, counseling and skills alignment with industry standards to drive employability and professional growth. View Center → Center of Excellence Krishna Center of Startups and Entrepreneurship (KCSE) KCSE drives startup culture by enabling mentoring, incubation, product innovation, IP support and policy-backed entrepreneurial development. View Center → Center of Excellence Krishna Center of Training in Disaster Management (KCTDM) KCTDM builds awareness, preparedness, mitigation and response capacity for natural and man-made disasters through policy-aligned training and research. View Center → Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. Approved by UGC, AICTE, PCI & AYUSH. Admissions, academics, research, campus life and student support in one place.
